description: You are a GIS Lead at a regional planning authority. Set up a dual-workspace geospatial data portal in GeoServer at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (admin / Admin123!). Complete all of the following: (1) Create workspace 'infrastructure' with namespace URI 'http://infrastructure.authority.gov/gis'. (2) Create workspace 'environment' with namespace URI 'http://environment.authority.gov/gis'. (3) Create a PostGIS datastore 'infra_data' in 'infrastructure' connecting to gs-postgis:5432/gis (geoserver/geoserver123). (4) Create a PostGIS datastore 'env_data' in 'environment' connecting to the same database. (5) Publish ne_populated_places from infra_data as layer 'settlements' in infrastructure. (6) Publish ne_rivers from env_data as layer 'waterways' in environment. (7) Create SLD style 'settlement_marker' with circle mark, orange fill #FFA500, size 8. (8) Create SLD style 'waterway_line' with blue line stroke #0080FF, width 2. (9) Apply settlement_marker as default style for infrastructure:settlements and waterway_line as default for environment:waterways. (10) Create a global layer group named 'regional_portal' containing both infrastructure:settlements and environment:waterways.
